hypothesis: Policy over-activation of 2B2R Ultra leads to sub-optimal long-term win rates due to hand dilution; holding components preserves strategic flexibility and improves match outcomes.
independentVariable: AI policy 2B2R valuation weight (ultraBonus: default +300 vs ablated 0 vs negative -200)
stratification: opening hand singleton count (holding A/K/Q vs not)
replayRetention: Certified replays retained for all matches ending in <= 4 Full Turns
counterfactualUsage: Apply counterfactual.mjs at the 2B2R decision point to evaluate 3-turn downstream state projection
falsificationCriterion: If the policy that suppresses early 2B2R achieves an equal or higher win rate across 200 matches, the hypothesis of 2B2R mechanical overpoweredness is falsified (confirmed as an AI policy artifact).
stopCondition: Completion of 200 paired matches or early statistical significance boundary reached
